observations.method: Two read-only filtered process snapshots; one battery and sleep assertion snapshot. Not a controlled energy measurement.

constraints: CPU snapshots are not power readings and concern an inactive helper only.
Source findings do not establish the versions installed on the mobile devices.
Timer rates assume continued scheduling; they are not deep-sleep wake counts.
Atomic write requests are not a count of physical flash flushes.
DPD scheduling depends on channel receive activity, server keepalives and protocol state.
Android setMetered(false) inherits underlying meteredness; it is not an unmetered override.
No VPN setting, connection, app binary or device battery-stat history was changed.
